At Total Family Solutions, we believe every individual and family deserves support, guidance, and a path toward healthier, stronger relationships. Since 2003, we’ve been proud to serve communities throughout Florida with compassionate, high-quality mental health care. We offer outpatient and telehealth counseling for families, couples, individuals, and first responders, ensuring accessible support tailored to your unique needs.

Our dedicated Florida team works closely with local communities to provide personalized, effective treatment that empowers you to grow and thrive.

To learn more about how our services can support you, call our Florida office at 352.831.8090 or fax us at 352.955.8090.

Our specialists are ready to help you build stronger connections and achieve your personal and family goals!
